args.title: Fix weekly export schedules skipping their first run
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In `nextRunAt`, the "daily" case only advances to the next day when the computed run time has already passed today (`if (next <= from) next.setUTCDate(...)`), but the "weekly" case unconditionally adds 7 days regardless of whether today's run hour (RUN_HOUR_UTC) has already passed relative to `from`.

This means a weekly schedule created earlier in the day than RUN_HOUR_UTC (e.g. created at 05:40 UTC with RUN_HOUR_UTC = 6) skips its first eligible run that same day and instead schedules a week later, even though the run time hasn't passed yet. This matches the reported behavior: a weekly export created Monday morning before the run hour sent nothing that day and only started the following Monday, while one created after the run hour behaved as expected by coincidence.

Proposed fix: mirror the daily logic for the weekly case — only add 7 days if `next <= from`; otherwise keep `next` (today's run hour) as the next run. This ensures a weekly schedule created before the day's run hour fires on its creation day instead of skipping a week.
